Hoa states that the pain started after she attempted lifting a heavy piece of furniture yesterday. Hoa also endorses that the pain is even more severe when she attempts to bend or stretch her back. You obtain MRI of the thoracic spine, which reveals diffuse osseous metastatic lesions with a severe pathologic fracture at T6.
